description: SHAPED FOR YOUR EVERY STRIDE  Incredibly lightweight with a smooth transition, the nike LunarElite+ model of shoes for men are designed for those who love to run. Without sacrificing on cushioning and shock absorption, the nike LunarElite+ range of shoes is designed in such a manner that it adapts to your stride &ndash  be it long or short.  Great deal for underpronators and overpronators  The Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes are specially engineered for runners with underpronated to moderately overpronated gait. Underpronated and overpronated runners strike the ground at the lateral side of the heel. As the individual transfers weight from the heel to the metatarsus, the foot doesn&rsquo t roll enough in the medial (inside) direction for overpronators and in the lateral (outside) direction for underpronators, which could affect the knee as the foot doesn&rsquo t absorb shock properly. However, the difference lies in the fact that in an underpronator, the ankles do not experience much motion and are rigid, while in an overpronator, the ankles roll inwards making one fall forward easily. Nike realized that it had the responsibility to create the right running shoes that could cater to both underpronators and overpronators, with ample support on both, the lateral and medial sides. This responsibility that it took up resulted in the creation of the Nike LunarElite+ model of shoes.  360 degrees of comfort  Without sacrificing on cushioning, the Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes was created with ultra-light, yet ultra-strong Flywire upper. The Flywire is a lightweight support system that is made of tensile fibres that are joined together to create a foundation to construct the upper material of the shoe. It acts like a super strong synthetic ligament, wrapping around the foot and supporting it precisely where it needs that extra support, mapping the foot morphology like an X-ray. Flywire acts like the second skin giving the runner that ultimate freedom and strength in moving backwards, forwards, sideways, up and down. Think of the direction and Nike LunarElite+ shoes will help you move that way with complete convenience, locking your foot down.  This range of shoes is created with open mesh uppers with strategic overlays for enhanced support at targeted areas of the upper foot to enhance performance, comfort and breathability. The no-sew design employed in key zones ensure proper fitting and enhance comfort.  To add to this snug Fit of the upper is the Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that adds on a plush cushioning to absorb shock protecting the feet, besides adding that extra spring in gait. The dynamic support system adapts to the runner&rsquo s stride, adding that specific support to every phase of the run.  Ultimate in protection  Besides, Nike LunarElite+ shoes are engineered with a dual layer Ortholite insole that is strong and breathable, replete with anti-microbial foam, making this model of shoes ideal for athletes. The cushioned sockliner is made of long lasting material and adds an exceptional step-in feel, while the memory foam at the collar ensures absolute comfort and fit.  The Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes are made of environmentally preferred rubber and employ a modified waffle outsole that makes the shoes durable and multi-surface tractional. The heel unit is made of highly durable carbon rubber, reducing wear and tear, while the flex grooves enhance flexibility, ensuring a smooth and efficient Nike run.  Shoe care  1. description: EXPERIENCE THE JOY OF FRESH RUNS An absolutely dynamic running shoe, the nike Lunarswift+ offers seamless comfort, distance-busting cushioning and runner specific support. Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a springy effect for the feet. The Nike Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer feel to the underfoot. It’s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the medial and lateral side of the shoe. Breezy touch to snug shoes With a stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot. Adapts to the runner's needs Light in weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the runner’s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer’s stride through each run giving the right amount of support and stability. No wonder overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting this same shoe into a neutral running shoe. Stay safe in the dark The outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. Added to these features are the reflective elements used in the shoe to ensure that you are visible even when running in low visibility conditions, keeping you safe. Belonging to the Nike+ range, the Nike Lunarswift+ is compatible with all Nike+ products and actually talks to your iPod nano and other compatible guaging devices. So enjoy those long runs through all seasons in this pleasurable range of Nike Lunarswift+ shoes. description: EXPERIENCE THE JOY OF FRESH RUNS  An  absolutely dynamic running shoe, the nike Lunarswift+ offers seamless  comfort, distance-busting cushioning and runner specific support.  Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a  springy effect for the feet.  The Nike  Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer  feel to the underfoot. It&rsquo s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators  and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the  medial and lateral side of the shoe.  Breezy touch to snug shoes  With a  stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet  and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed  using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample  ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during  long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and  move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and  out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely  snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot.  Adapts to the runner's needs  Light in  weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are  employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up  of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam  carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy  response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the  runner&rsquo s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer&rsquo s stride through each  run giving the right amount of support and stability.  No wonder  overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in  the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight  or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral  pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such  runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting  this same shoe into a neutral running shoe.  Stay safe in the dark  The  outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and  breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an  outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern  outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. Added  to these features are the reflective elements used in the shoe to ensure  that you are visible even when running in low visibility conditions,  keeping you safe.  Belonging  to the Nike+ range, the Nike Lunarswift+ is compatible with all Nike+  products and actually talks to your iPod nano and other compatible  guaging devices. So enjoy those long runs through all seasons in this  pleasurable range of Nike Lunarswift+ shoes. THEY RESPOND TO YOUR RUN  If you’re looking for the most cushioned running experience, you’re looking at the absolute shoe – the nike Zoom Vomero+ 5. A refined performance classic, the nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 shoe combines the best of its predecessor, the Nike Zoom Vomero, the Vomero+ 5 has an enhanced Fit, smoother ride and lighter weight. In fact, unlike the earlier version, the Vomero+ 5 has a breathable open mesh upper with no-sew overlays through the forefoot to ensure a snug, secure and seam free fit. This style of bonding of the shoe not only enhances support to the foot, it also reduces chaffing and irritation.  Weighing an average of just about 329 grams, the Nike Zoom units employed in the sole region of the Nike Zoom Vomero+5 range of shoes ensure lightweight, responsive cushioning, making running an experience to reckon with.  Flex and stretch as much as you like  An absolute in comfort for underpronators to neutral gait runners with normal to high arches, the Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 falls under the neutral category of running shoes . These shoes have elastic mesh panels for a lockdown and adaptable fit of the feet. The stretch panels work along with the other parts of the shoe and ensure that the middle part of the foot is kept locked and in place, while allowing it to stretch and flex with absolute ease, comfort and support.  The Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5, which weighs an average of 278 grams for women’s shoes and 329 grams for men’s shoes, has an external heel counter that wraps around the heel for a snug fit. What comes as a cherry on the icing with the Nike Vomero+ 5 shoe is the inner-sleeve or bootie for a plush fit and comfort. The Vomero+ 5, in fact, is much loved by runners for its heel and forefoot responsive cushioning created by the Nike Zoom units, besides, of course, a full length, soft midsole for added durability and cushioning.  Segmented heel for quick moves  The Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 shoe has a crash pad below the heel that is more segmented than its earlier models. This ensures better shock absorption, smoother transition and cushioning when the heel strikes the ground. There are extensions of blown rubber infused in the heel to provide a smoother and more efficient stride even when enhancing cushioning. There is an additional injected phylon (IP) pressure path under the arch to ensure that the feet are in contact with the ground, adding to the stability and impact guidance system factor.  Safe runs at dusk  All of the Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 shoes are constructed with reflective elements so that runners can enjoy their sport even under low visibility, with safety. These shoes also come with arch supports to ensure stability while the feet move naturally. There are, in fact, multiple types or rubber and traction patterns employed to ensure that the running stride is kept smooth, allowing the knees and feet to stay in shape. With flex grooves in place, there’s an abundance of flexibility and smooth, efficient runs that you can earn with this Nike+ range. Add on Nike+ compatible products like your goal and workout monitors and there’s no stopping you. AN ACE FOR THE ACERS  Your quest for the most comfortable tennis shoe has come to an end with the Gel Challenger 8 from asics. The perfect shoe for the diehard tennis fan, the asics Gel Challenger 8 comes with great durability and traction, besides smart colours that make it a cross between a fashionable lifestyle shoe and a country club conservative.  Offering utmost grip and stability on hard tennis courts, the support of the inner arch of medial region of the foot in the Asics Gel Challenger 8 is to-die-for. Engineered with firm gel cushioning, it is an extremely comfortable and non-compromising tennis shoe. It has a durable rubber outsole and in structured for lightweight comfort.  Get aggressive in style  The Asics Gel Challenger 8 ensures high performance for aggressive players. Constructed with a standard length and medium Fit and arch, the upper of this shoe is constructed using synthetic leather and a polyester-based mesh for enhanced ventilation and dry-fit comfort. There is a PGuard employed at the toe area to improve durability, and a personal Heel Fit collar that locks the heel in place and provides added comfort and impact protection to the heel. The ankle receives co much comfort and support that you can keep your ankle supports away and comfortably slip into the Asics Challenger 8 shoe.  Side-to-side movement made easy  The midsole of the shoe is employed with the Asics Gel Cushioning system for that extra comfort that protects the feet from impact during a competitive game of tennis. Injected with Solyte 55 inserts, the midsole is made all the more lighter than the Asics standard EVA or SpEVA footbeds. This offers improved cushioning and durability, along with a speed oriented feel making it extremely easy for tennis players to make those side-to-side movements. The rearfoot and forefoot offers ample cushioning and support in the right points of the foot, protecting the feet completely from shock.  Modified tread for great traction  The outsole of the Asics Gel Challenger 8 is made of Asics High Abrasion Resistant Rubber or AHAR for increased durability. Created using a modified tread pattern, this tennis shoe provides non-marking traction on all court surfaces. The forefoot and rearfoot and joined together by a plastic shank called the Trusstic System that offers excellent midfoot support, allowing ample traction across various surfaces. This plastic shank doesn't touch the ground and instead wraps neatly around the inner arch of the foot, providing distinct grip and support for good court movement.  A great shoe for the hardcore tennis buff, the Asics Gel Challenger 8 works best without thick socks as the heel seat is slightly low. So gear up, step into these wondrous shoes and surprise yourself with those winning aces. GREET YOUR FEET WITH GREAT RUNS  If you are a mild to moderate overpronator looking for a daily running shoe, here's the best bet brought to you by asics. Renowned for its Fit, balanced   and cushioned ride and smooth heel to toe transition, the updated version of the asics GT 2000, the Asics GT 2160 makes you enjoy the best performance everytime. The shoe has an increased memory foam along the heel collar and forefoot, ensuring that the Asics GT 2160 offers plush cushioning and excellent shock absorption.  With stability coming as an award-winning heritage factor, the Asics GT 2160 stability running shoe has overcome those few weaknesses found in the 2150 version, making it a pleasure to run in. Reverting to the Asics GT 2140's close fit, the toe box is also narrower compared to the GT 2150, preventing the foot from shifting around in the shoe.  Narrow or broad, take your pick  This update of the Spring 2011 running collection, the GT 2160 is the lightest running shoe of the GT 2100 series. With the lightweight feature of the GT series still intact, the GT 2160 men's shoe has increased by only 1 oz to 11.5 oz, and the women's shoe stands the same at 9.6 oz. However, unlike its predecessors, the GT 2160 doesn't have an asymmetrical lacing system, but the good old straight lacing system to provide a snug fit, locking the foot in place.  The Asics GT 2160 works wonders for those who have a narrow heel as this range of asics shoes comes with narrow sizing options. Highly recommended for overpronators, the Asics GT 2160 running shoe has an improved and more responsive cushioning that greatly contributes towards making it a long term running partner.  Torsion stability with midfoot support  The GT 2160 is employed with the Duo Max stability system, which is a harder piece of foam injected into the midsole mould, especially around the medial (inside) area of the foot, extending from below the ankle to the mid-heel, making it an ideal shoe for overpronators. This medial support can easily be recognized by its standardised grey colour that prevents the arch from collapsing excessively when running. This running shoe is also employed with the Asics Space Trusstic System stability feature that enhances midfoot support.  On the outsole, this midfoot support is represented by a thermal plastic unit or TPU bridge that wraps around the midsole right under the inner arch of the foot, offering torsional stability. This helps prevent the foot from rotating unnaturally. However, the Trusstic System in the GT 2160 is different in men's and women's shoes, with the women's shoe having amore extended bridge that wraps the foot higher enhancing stability, as women has a wider Q-angle.  Decoupled heel for plush rides  For that extra cushioning, two units of the Asics Gel cushioning system is employed in the heel and forefoot of the Asics GT 2160. The forefoot is made much more plush, while the decoupled heel absorbs shock according to the manner in which the foot lands on the ground, distributing the impact evenly and cushioning the feet from injuries. The main change in the outsole of the Asics 2160 is that it has an Impact Guidance System (IGS). The IGS is a longitudinal groove carved in the midsole. This groove guides the foot through the most efficient stride and also reduces the weight of the shoe, enhancing running speed.  Great mileage for great runners  Constructed with synthetic overlays, the upper of the GT 2160 wraps tightly around keeping the foot locked down in place. It is employed with a rich and removable sockliner that allows the runner to fit an orthotic into the shoe for added ergonomic comfort. The ComforDry sockliner of the Asics GT 2160 provides extra amortization and anti-microbial technology that reduces bad odour and keeps the feet fresh and dry. The heel collar of the GT 2160 includes memory foam on the inside and outside, making it all the more plush and comfortable.  One of the best running shoes ever created this season, the GT 2160 is a great wear for mild to moderate overpronators. Offering plenty of support and great mileage, the Asics GT 2160 is a great buy for serious runners. SHAPED FOR YOUR EVERY STRIDE  Incredibly  lightweight with a smooth transition, the nike LunarElite+ model of  shoes for men are designed for those who love to run. Without  sacrificing on cushioning and shock absorption, the nike LunarElite+  range of shoes is designed in such a manner that it adapts to your  stride &ndash  be it long or short.  Great deal for underpronators and overpronators  The Nike  LunarElite+ range of shoes are specially engineered for runners with  underpronated to moderately overpronated gait. Underpronated and  overpronated runners strike the ground at the lateral side of the heel.  As the individual transfers weight from the heel to the metatarsus, the  foot doesn&rsquo t roll enough in the medial (inside) direction for  overpronators and in the lateral (outside) direction for underpronators,  which could affect the knee as the foot doesn&rsquo t absorb shock properly.  However, the difference lies in the fact that in an underpronator, the  ankles do not experience much motion and are rigid, while in an  overpronator, the ankles roll inwards making one fall forward easily.  Nike realized that it had the responsibility to create the right running shoes that could cater to both underpronators and overpronators, with  ample support on both, the lateral and medial sides. This responsibility  that it took up resulted in the creation of the Nike LunarElite+ model  of shoes.  360 degrees of comfort  Without  sacrificing on cushioning, the Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes was  created with ultra-light, yet ultra-strong Flywire upper. The Flywire is  a lightweight support system that is made of tensile fibres that are  joined together to create a foundation to construct the upper material  of the shoe. It acts like a super strong synthetic ligament, wrapping  around the foot and supporting it precisely where it needs that extra  support, mapping the foot morphology like an X-ray. Flywire acts like  the second skin giving the runner that ultimate freedom and strength in  moving backwards, forwards, sideways, up and down. Think of the  direction and Nike LunarElite+ shoes will help you move that way with  complete convenience, locking your foot down.  This  range of shoes is created with open mesh uppers with strategic overlays  for enhanced support at targeted areas of the upper foot to enhance  performance, comfort and breathability. The no-sew design employed in  key zones ensure proper fitting and enhance comfort.  To add to  this snug Fit of the upper is the Lunarlon cushioning system in the  midsole that adds on a plush cushioning to absorb shock protecting the  feet, besides adding that extra spring in gait. The dynamic support  system adapts to the runner&rsquo s stride, adding that specific support to  every phase of the run.  Ultimate in protection  Besides,  Nike LunarElite+ shoes are engineered with a dual layer Ortholite insole  that is strong and breathable, replete with anti-microbial foam, making  this model of shoes ideal for athletes. The cushioned sockliner is made  of long lasting material and adds an exceptional step-in feel, while  the memory foam at the collar ensures absolute comfort and fit.  The Nike  LunarElite+ range of shoes are made of environmentally preferred rubber  and employ a modified waffle outsole that makes the shoes durable and  multi-surface tractional. The heel unit is made of highly durable carbon  rubber, reducing wear and tear, while the flex grooves enhance  flexibility, ensuring a smooth and efficient Nike run.  Shoe care 1. Spring and sprint far and wide  The winning design of the Zig Sonic finds the shoe fitted with an inch  of zig- zagging slab of engineered foam in the outsole, making it a  lightweight shoe. This  zig-zag styled sole absorbs impact during  heelstrike and spreads the shock along the  long winding lines, helping  you propel further with much force, ease and comfort. Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a springy effect for the feet. The Nike Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer feel to the underfoot. It’s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the medial and lateral side of the shoe. Breezy touch to snug shoes With a stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot. Adapts to the runner's needs Light in weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the runner’s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer’s stride through each run giving the right amount of support and stability. No wonder overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting this same shoe into a neutral running shoe. Stay safe in the dark The outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. Added to these features are the reflective elements used in the shoe to ensure that you are visible even when running in low visibility conditions, keeping you safe. Belonging to the Nike+ range, the Nike Lunarswift+ is compatible with all Nike+ products and actually talks to your iPod nano and other compatible gauging devices. So enjoy those long runs through all seasons in this pleasurable range of Nike Lunarswift+ shoes. It adopts to the wearer’s stride through each run giving the right amount of support and stability. Stay safe in the dark The outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Traditionally, runners needed to decided between  ventilation for the feet and safety from wet conditions. Another factor that makes the Nike Air Max 2003 stand apart from the  rest of the shoes in this series is that it was the first Air Max shoe  that did not have any foam in the midsole. This technology was employed  to its fullest and marketed with vigour when Nike released its Air Max  360 model. This clean look of the Nike Air Max 2003 makes it a great wear not just  on the track, but also off-track around the town. description: EXPERIENCE THE JOY OF FRESH RUNS An absolutely dynamic running shoe, the nike Lunarswift+ offers seamless comfort, distance-busting cushioning and runner specific support. Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a springy effect for the feet. The Nike Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer feel to the underfoot. It’s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the medial and lateral side of the shoe. Breezy touch to snug shoes With a stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot. Adapts to the runner's needs Light in weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the runner’s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer’s stride through each run giving the right amount of support and stability. No wonder overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting this same shoe into a neutral running shoe. Stay safe in the dark The outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. Added to these features are the reflective elements used in the shoe to ensure that you are visible even when running in low visibility conditions, keeping you safe. Belonging to the Nike+ range, the Nike Lunarswift+ is compatible with all Nike+ products and actually talks to your iPod nano and other compatible gauging devices. So enjoy those long runs through all seasons in this pleasurable range of Nike Lunarswift+ shoes. description: SHAPED FOR YOUR EVERY STRIDE Incredibly lightweight with a smooth transition, the nike LunarElite+2 model of shoes are designed for those who love to run. Without sacrificing on cushioning and shock absorption, the nike LunarElite+2 shoe is designed in such a manner that it adapts to your stride – be it long or short. Great deal for underpronators and overpronators The Nike LunarElite+2 is specially engineered for runners with underpronated to moderately overpronated gait. Underpronated and overpronated runners strike the ground at the lateral side of the heel. As the individual transfers weight from the heel to the metatarsus, the foot doesn’t roll enough in the medial (inside) direction for overpronators and in the lateral (outside) direction for underpronators, which could affect the knee as the foot doesn’t absorb shock properly. However, the difference lies in the fact that in an underpronator, the ankles do not experience much motion and are rigid, while in an overpronator, the ankles roll inwards making one fall forward easily. Nike realized that it had the responsibility to create the right running shoes that could cater to both underpronators and overpronators, with ample support on both, the lateral and medial sides. This responsibility that it took up resulted in the creation of the Nike LunarElite+ model of shoes. 360 degrees of comfort Without sacrificing on cushioning, the Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes was created with ultra-light, yet ultra-strong Flywire upper. The Flywire is a lightweight support system that is made of tensile fibres that are joined together to create a foundation to construct the upper material of the shoe. It acts like a super strong synthetic ligament, wrapping around the foot and supporting it precisely where it needs that extra support, mapping the foot morphology like an X-ray. Flywire acts like the second skin giving the runner that ultimate freedom and strength in moving backwards, forwards, sideways, up and down. Think of the direction and Nike LunarElite+ shoes will help you move that way with complete convenience, locking your foot down. This range of shoes is created with open mesh uppers with strategic overlays for enhanced support at targeted areas of the upper foot to enhance performance, comfort and breathability. The no-sew design employed in key zones ensure proper fitting and enhance comfort. To add to this snug Fit of the upper is the Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that adds on a plush cushioning to absorb shock protecting the feet, besides adding that extra spring in gait. The dynamic support system adapts to the runner’s stride, adding that specific support to every phase of the run. Ultimate in protection Besides, Nike LunarElite+ shoes are engineered with a dual layer Ortholite insole that is strong and breathable, replete with anti-microbial foam, making this model of shoes ideal for athletes. The cushioned sockliner is made of long lasting material and adds an exceptional step-in feel, while the memory foam at the collar ensures absolute comfort and fit. The Nike LunarElite+ range of shoes are made of environmentally preferred rubber and employ a modified waffle outsole that makes the shoes durable and multi-surface tractional. The heel unit is made of highly durable carbon rubber, reducing wear and tear, while the flex grooves enhance flexibility, ensuring a smooth and efficient Nike run. description: BACK TO THE FUTURE  Stretch  yourself, push your limits further away and overcome those long tough  runs in the asics Gel Phoenix 3 running shoes . Designed for the runner  who knows how to conquer the toughest of the tough, this super strong  running shoe from asics is replete with enhanced stability and  cushioning, and is specially recommended for those with a mild  overpronated gait.  The  Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is made of lightweight material, helping its  creators keep its weight at just about 9 oz. Constructed using synthetic  material, the upper of this shoe is meshed enhancing breathability,  keeping the feet dry and fresh even after a long run. Added to this  meshed upper are synthetic overlays that add structure and durable  support to the shoe. The upper is also fitted with reflective elements  that make it a safe wear even in low light conditions.  The  inside of the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is employed with a padded tongue and  sockliner that not only provides a soft and cushioned feel, but also  locks the rearfoot in place, ensuring a snug Fit and protection from  shock. The contoured sockliner in the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 offers a  lightweight plush feel, and is removable allowing runners to place an  orthotic for better comfort.  Return of energy   The  midsole of the Asics Gel Phoenix 3 is made of highly resilient SpEVA  that offers excellent energy return allowing greater and more  comfortable propulsion. Created of DuoMax dual density, the midsole is  positioned in a  specific manner to enhance stability and support when  running. The midsole comfort and stability is further enhanced using a  California Slip Lasting, while the upper is stitched around the EVA  board and directly attached to the midsole to offer a seamless fit and  abrasion-free comfort. The rearfoot is employed with a Rearfoot Gel  cushioning system that attenuates shock, allowing for a smooth  transition to mid-distance.  Durability at its best   Created  using Asics High Abrasion Rubber (AHAR), the outsole of the Asics Gel  Phoenix 3 is known for its supreme durability. This AHAR technology is  placed strategically in those parts of the outsole that is especially  prone to wear and tear, enhancing shoe life. The forefoot is made of  flex grooves for easy movement, while the forefoot and heel of the  outsole connected with the Asics Trusstic System, which is a plastic  shank wrapping neatly around the medial side of the foot, reducing the  overall weight of the sole unit and retaining the structural integrity  of the shoe. description: THE KING OF CUSHIONED shoes  Designed with a great amount of soft and plush cushioning, the asics Gel Nimbus 12 has become a referral model for other shoes engineered with cushioning technology. Offering absolute stability, these running shoes are highly recommended for neutral runners and moderate overpronators who begin to feel the stress of their gait otherwise during long runs.  Gender specific engineering  The asics Gel Nimbus 12 is engineered with Gel technology in its midsole, with goblets of silicon based gel inserted in the forefoot and heel to enhance shock absorption and protect the feet from impact. The midsole is cushioned with a Solyte foam for lightweight comfort.  But what makes the Asics Gel Nimbus 12 stand apart is that it merges its cushioning elements with its support features, ensuring that the runner's gait is kept correct and steady. The base of the Asics Gel Nimbus 12 is wide, providing ample stability, while the heel is decoupled to provide that right amount of shock absorption in the right places. In the women's version of this shoe, the heel is 3mm higher than the men's range, relieving stress from the Achilles tendon.  Bridge of comfort and stability  The most important characteristic of the Nimbus is its Space Trusstic System. This is a transition bridge that embraces the midsole under the arch of the foot, providing torsion stability during heelstrike and toe-off. This plastic shank in the outsole ensures that the foot doesn't twist unnaturally, keeping it safe from injuries.  This transition bridge made of a solid plastic compound is only employed on the medial or inner side of the underfoot to give the shoe the ultimate in stability. This shank is also specifically engineered for men and women, making it a nearly customised running shoe ever created.  The outsole is also employed with the Asics special Impact Guidance System - a vertical flex groove that extends from the toe to the heel ensuring a proper gait during every stride.  Busy shoe for busy runners  The upper of the Asics Gel Nimbus 12 is richly featured, giving it a busy look. With a well executed collar and heel liner filled with memory foam, the heel is locked comfortably in the shoe, keeping it safe from impact and injuries. The upper is also employed with an asymmetrical lacing system, where the laces are in a curved line along the natural shape of the foot. This locks the foot perfectly in place providing a more snug and comfort Fit.  What's also special about this shoe is that it has individual and independent eyelets that are connected with several overlays to the midsole, giving the Asics Gel Nimbus 12 a classy look.  Wash care Wipe surface with soft, clean, cloth or brush, cold water and mild detergent to remove dust Do not machine wash or use a drier Avoid storing shoes in extremely hot conditions or in sunlight

description: THEY RESPOND TO YOUR RUN If you’re looking for the most cushioned running experience, you’re looking at the absolute shoe – the nike Zoom Vomero+ 5. A refined performance classic, the nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 shoe combines the best of its predecessor, the Nike Zoom Vomero, the Vomero+ 5 has an enhanced Fit, smoother ride and lighter weight. In fact, unlike the earlier version, the Vomero+ 5 has a breathable open mesh upper with no-sew overlays through the forefoot to ensure a snug, secure and seam free fit. This style of bonding of the shoe not only enhances support to the foot, it also reduces chaffing and irritation. Weighing an average of just about 329 grams, the Nike Zoom units employed in the sole region of the Nike Zoom Vomero+5 range of shoes ensure lightweight, responsive cushioning, making running an experience to reckon with. Flex and stretch as much as you like An absolute in comfort for underpronators to neutral gait runners with normal to high arches, the Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 falls under the neutral category of running shoes . These shoes have elastic mesh panels for a lockdown and adaptable fit of the feet. The stretch panels work along with the other parts of the shoe and ensure that the middle part of the foot is kept locked and in place, while allowing it to stretch and flex with absolute ease, comfort and support. The Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5, which weighs an average of 278 grams for women’s shoes and 329 grams for men’s shoes, has an external heel counter that wraps around the heel for a snug fit. What comes as a cherry on the icing with the Nike Vomero+ 5 shoe is the inner-sleeve or bootie for a plush fit and comfort. The Vomero+ 5, in fact, is much loved by runners for its heel and forefoot responsive cushioning created by the Nike Zoom units, besides, of course, a full length, soft midsole for added durability and cushioning. Segmented heel for quick moves The Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 shoe has a crash pad below the heel that is more segmented than its earlier models. This ensures better shock absorption, smoother transition and cushioning when the heel strikes the ground. There are extensions of blown rubber infused in the heel to provide a smoother and more efficient stride even when enhancing cushioning. There is an additional injected phylon (IP) pressure path under the arch to ensure that the feet are in contact with the ground, adding to the stability and impact guidance system factor. Safe runs at dusk All of the Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 shoes are constructed with reflective elements so that runners can enjoy their sport even under low visibility, with safety. These shoes also come with arch supports to ensure stability while the feet move naturally. There are, in fact, multiple types or rubber and traction patterns employed to ensure that the running stride is kept smooth, allowing the knees and feet to stay in shape. With flex grooves in place, there’s an abundance of flexibility and smooth, efficient runs that you can earn with this Nike+ range. Add on Nike+ compatible products like your goal and workout monitors and there’s no stopping you.
